source.stem:
Multiple choice question: Which of the following statements about gymnosperms and angiosperms is correct ( )
A. The seeds of gymnosperms are covered with pericarp.
B. The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
C. Gymnosperm seeds are exposed
D. The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

options.text: The seeds of gymnosperms are covered by a pericarp
The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

intelligence.enrichment: Trees are really tall plants with hard, thick, brown, woody stems and branches that usually start higher up; shrubs are not as tall as trees and have many hard brown woody stems branching close to the ground; herbs are typically small with soft green stems; climbers have weak stems that need support; creepers creep along the ground. height_stem_branching_support_features -> plant_group The learner correctly applies this rule: Trees are really tall plants with hard, thick, brown, woody stems and branches that usually start higher up; shrubs are not as tall as trees and have many hard brown woody stems branching close to the ground; herbs are typically small with soft green stems; climbers have weak stems that need support; creepers creep along the ground. Any plant with a hard brown stem is a tree; small green plants are herbs, and all weak-stem plants belong to one weak-stem group.
